meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以把目录、网页、粘贴的笔记或本次对话中的操作步骤,整理成一个可复用的技能文件,写入 .claude/skills/<名字>/SKILL.md;若已有对应技能,则用新内容更新它。
howto.when: 当你说出“/learn”等指令,或要求“把这个变成技能”、“捕捉这个工作流”、“改进某个技能”时触发。

say.note: 会读取目录并整理成技能文件。
会抓取页面并提炼可复用步骤。

say.text: 把刚才我们做的事学成技能
say.note: 会从本次对话中提炼流程并保存。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can turn a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or the workflow from the current conversation into a reusable skill, saved as .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. If a matching skill already exists, it updates that skill with the new learnings.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'.

say_en.note: Reads the directory and distills it into a skill file.

say_en.text: Turn this webpage into a skill
say_en.note: Fetches the page and extracts reusable steps.
Distills the conversation's workflow and saves it.
